sloka: शापस्य अन्तम् उपागम्य तेषाम् दर्शनम् आगता।राघवौ तु ततः तस्याः पादौ जगृहतुः मुदा ॥१-४९-१७॥
transliteration: śāpasya antam upāgamya teṣām darśanam āgatā।rāghavau tu tataḥ tasyāḥ pādau jagṛhatuḥ mudā ॥1-49-17॥

translations.english: Recalling the words of Gautama, she received them with water to wash their feet and offerings made with due devotion Rama accepted her hospitality extended in accordance tradition.
translations.hindi: उसी. का महातेजस्वी, परम प्रसिद्ध और . दुर्जेय पुत्र राजा सुमति आजकल इस विशाला पुरी में राज्य करता है
